---
title: "scRNA Coexpression Modules"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

## Purpose

Build simple feature coexpression modules and store module scores in Seurat metadata.

## Packages

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-08-coexpression-modules-packages
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Load only the packages used in this template.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(qs2)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
})
```

## User Config

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-08-coexpression-modules-user-config
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# USER INPUT:
input_object <- "path/to/seurat_clustered.qs"
module_file <- "path/to/modules.tsv"
output_object <- "path/to/seurat_coexpression_modules.qs"
results_dir <- "results/coexpression_modules"
figures_dir <- "figures/coexpression_modules"
assay_name <- "RNA"
sample_column <- "sample_column"
group_column <- "group_column"
module_column <- "module_name"
gene_column <- "gene_symbol"
seed <- 1
n_threads <- 4
compress_level <- 6
```

## Input Loading

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-08-coexpression-modules-input-loading
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Create output folders and load configured inputs.
set.seed(seed)
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
object <- qs2::qs_read(file = input_object, nthreads = n_threads)
modules <- readr::read_tsv(module_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
DefaultAssay(object) <- assay_name
```

## Validation

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-08-coexpression-modules-validation
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Stop early when required inputs or columns are missing.
stopifnot(inherits(object, "Seurat"))
stopifnot(all(c(module_column, gene_column) %in% colnames(modules)))
stopifnot(all(c(sample_column, group_column) %in% colnames(object[[]])))
```

## Input Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-08-coexpression-modules-input-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Write a small TSV summary of the loaded input.
module_summary <- modules |> count(.data[[module_column]], name = "n_genes")
readr::write_tsv(module_summary, file.path(results_dir, "module_input_summary.tsv"))
module_summary
```

## Main Analysis

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-08-coexpression-modules-main-analysis
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Run the reusable analysis step for this template.
module_sets <- split(modules[[gene_column]], modules[[module_column]])
module_sets <- lapply(module_sets, intersect, rownames(object))
module_sets <- module_sets[lengths(module_sets) > 0]
object <- AddModuleScore(object, features = module_sets, name = "coexpression_module_")
module_score_cols <- tail(colnames(object[[]]), length(module_sets))
names(module_score_cols) <- names(module_sets)
```

## QC Checks

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-08-coexpression-modules-qc-checks
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export checks that make failures easy to inspect.
module_scores <- object[[]] |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
  select(cell_id, all_of(module_score_cols), all_of(c(sample_column, group_column)))
readr::write_tsv(module_scores, file.path(results_dir, "coexpression_module_scores.tsv"))
```

## Visualization

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-08-coexpression-modules-visualization
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save compact figures for the main outputs.
pdf(file.path(figures_dir, "coexpression_module_scores.pdf"), width = 8, height = 4)
print(VlnPlot(object, features = module_score_cols, group.by = group_column, pt.size = 0))
dev.off()
```

## Object Result Storage

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-08-coexpression-modules-object-result-storage
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Store reusable analysis metadata inside the object.
object@misc$coexpression_modules <- list(module_file = module_file, score_columns = module_score_cols)
```

## Result Export

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-08-coexpression-modules-result-export
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export the main reusable tables as TSV files.
readr::write_tsv(module_summary, file.path(results_dir, "coexpression_module_gene_counts.tsv"))
```

## Final Save

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-08-coexpression-modules-final-save
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save the updated object for the next template step.
qs2::qs_save(object, file = output_object, nthreads = n_threads, compress_level = compress_level)
```

## Output Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-08-coexpression-modules-output-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Print a compact summary of generated outputs.
tibble::tibble(output_object = output_object, modules_scored = length(module_score_cols))
```
